transactions.sale_price_citation: p2125: 'Kelsterbach DC was opportunistically divested to Fortinet GmbH for EUR 50.0 million or a 28.2% premium to its 31 December 2024 value of EUR 39.0 million'
transactions.citation: p2125: 'In March 2025, Kelsterbach DC was opportunistically divested to Fortinet GmbH for EUR 50.0 million or a 28.2% premium to its 31 December 2024 value of EUR 39.0 million by Savills (UK) Limited, an independent [valuer]'. Consideration also stated in Note (p6358): 'On 24 March 2025, the Group divested Kelsterbach DC for a consideration of approximately $70.6 million.'
transactions.notes: VERIFIED: the disclosed 28.2% is gross sale price EUR 50.0m vs the 31-Dec-2024 independent valuation EUR 39.0m by Savills (UK) Limited -- (50.0-39.0)/39.0*100 = 28.2%, ties out exactly. reference_value/currency recorded in EUR (the currency the disclosed % is actually computed in), not SGD, since mixing bases would misstate the premium. The AR separately states an approx. SGD-equivalent consideration of S$70.6m (Note d, p6358) -- this is a currency-converted restatement of the same EUR 50.0m gross price, NOT a different (net) figure; not used as reference_value to avoid basis confusion. Carrying value immediately pre-divestment was S$55,041k (Portfolio Statement 2024 column, p5588) -- a book_value figure distinct from and not to be conflated with the EUR 39.0m independent valuation used for the disclosed 28.2%. Gain on divestment of S$10.825m was recognised in the Statement of Profit or Loss (per prior extraction, not independently re-verified against a specific P&L line in this pass); true net-of-disposal-cost proceeds for Kelsterbach alone are not separately disclosed (Note B, p5497-5499, states only that net divestment proceeds were used to repay bank borrowings, without a standalone Kelsterbach net-proceeds figure).

transactions.property_name: Keppel DC Singapore 7 & 8 (remaining 51% / 0.51% economic interest in Memphis 1 Pte. Ltd.)
transactions.citation: p2600: 'In the second half of 2025, Keppel DC REIT acquired the remaining 0.51% economic interest in Keppel DC Singapore 7 and Keppel DC Singapore 8 (KDC SGP 7 and 8) on 3 September 2025'; equity consideration ~S$6.7m per Note 16(c) cash-flow financing line (p139, per prior extraction citation).
transactions.notes: Acquisition of the residual 0.51% economic interest (equity consideration ~S$6.682m) to complete 100% ownership of Memphis 1 Pte. Ltd., which holds KDC SGP 7 & 8; interest_pct 0.51 is the INCREMENT transacted, not the resulting total holding. No gain/loss concept applies to an acquisition of a non-controlling interest, so the five divestment fields are left null. The underlying property's agreed aggregate value (S$1,046.3m) and independent valuations (Knight Frank S$1,047.0m / Savills S$1,064.0m, dated 1 May 2025) relate to the whole property, not to this NCI step-up transaction price, so no reference_value is populated here to avoid mixing a 0.51%-interest price against a 100%-basis valuation.

transactions.counterparty: Sunrise Inzai 4 TMK (jointly acquired with Keppel Ltd.)
transactions.citation: p2600: 'strengthened its presence in Japan with the acquisition of Tokyo Data Centre 3 (Tokyo DC 3) on 19 November 2025'; Portfolio Statistics (p42, per prior extraction): attributable (98.47%) purchase price S$683.0m (JPY80,843.9m).
transactions.notes: Keppel DC REIT holds a 98.47% effective interest in Tokyo DC 3 (jointly acquired with Keppel Ltd.); purchase_price of S$683.0m is on the attributable 98.47% basis, consistent with interest_pct. No gain/loss concept applies to an acquisition; the five divestment fields are left null rather than populated with a derived acquisition-discount figure, since the AR does not disclose an explicit acquisition discount/premium percentage (only the underlying attributable valuation S$678.6m / JPY81,730.1m per JLL Morii Valuation dated 1 Sep 2025, from which a ~1.1% acquisition discount could be derived, but this is not the gain/loss concept the five fields are meant to capture).

transactions.property_name: Keppel DC Singapore 3 & 4 (remaining 10.0% interest in KDC SGP 3 and 1.0% interest in KDC SGP 4)
transactions.counterparty: Keppel Data Centres Holding Pte. Ltd.
transactions.citation: p161 (fn3): 'Includes investments in debt securities and the acquisition of remaining interests in Keppel DC Singapore 3 and Keppel DC Singapore 4 which was completed on 12 February 2026. Excluding the acquisition, assets under management would be approximately $6.2 billion.'; p239: 'we acquired the remaining interests in four data centres - Keppel DC Singapore 3, 4, 7 and 8 to achieve full ownership'.
transactions.notes: Subsequent-event acquisition (agreements entered Dec 2025, completed 12 Feb 2026, per Note 35 per prior extraction) -- disclosed as COMPLETED by the time the FY2025 AR was issued, so status recorded as 'completed' rather than 'announced'; deal_id year uses 2026 (the year the deal actually completed), per the SPEC's cross-year convention. interest_pct left null: the AR discloses two DIFFERENT increments in one aggregate consideration -- remaining 10.0% of KDC SGP 3 and remaining 1.0% of KDC SGP 4 -- which cannot be represented as a single interest_pct without conflating two distinct stakes into one number; a defensible single interest_pct would require splitting the S$50.5m aggregate consideration between the two assets, which the AR does not do. No independent valuation is disclosed for these interests, so the five divestment fields are otherwise null (not applicable to an acquisition in any case).

transactions.property_name: Basis Bay Data Centre (Basis Bay DC)
transactions.counterparty: Basis Bay Services MSC Sdn. Bhd.
transactions.citation: p418: 'Entered agreement for the sale of Basis Bay Data Centre, Cyberjaya, Malaysia to rebalance portfolio'; Note 4(ii) (p128, per prior extraction): SPA entered 2024, announced 2 Jan 2025, completion expected 1Q 2026; carrying value 31 Dec 2025 S$17,092k; portfolio valuation S$16.9m / RM53.9m as at 31 Dec 2025.
transactions.notes: Sale and purchase agreement signed (originally in 2024, publicly announced 2 Jan 2025); still NOT COMPLETED as at FYE 31 Dec 2025, with completion expected 1Q 2026 -- status recorded as 'announced', not 'completed'. The AR does NOT disclose a sale/consideration price for Basis Bay DC anywhere found in this report, only the held-for-sale carrying value (S$17,092k) and an independent portfolio valuation (S$16.9m / RM53.9m, both as at 31 Dec 2025). Because no transacted price exists, gain_loss_pct cannot be computed under either a disclosed or derived path and is correctly left null per SPEC rule 3 ('no defensible reference. Do not invent one') -- this is a genuine disclosure gap, not an extraction miss. deal_id uses year 2026 (expected completion year) since the deal has not yet completed; may need to be reconciled with a future FY2026 filing once the actual completion date is known.
